title: What Kind of Lover Are You?

plan.title: Too much of one thing, none of another
Why you hold on the way you do
How you fight, and how you say sorry (or don't)
How you show love vs how you need it
Yeon's red flag report on you
What you need (not what you chase)

fast.speaker: yeon
fast.text: Fast and hard, you said. So you've named the kids by date three. Let's check the brakes.

slow.speaker: bom
slow.text: Slowly, then all at once. The prettiest way to fall, and the scariest one.

overthink.speaker: yeon
overthink.text: "I don't fall, I overthink." You do fall. You just do it in your head first, for months, alone.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: You didn't say how you fall. That's fine. Your birthday already told on you.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. When you fall, you don't wait for permission. You decide, then inform them.

Bom: It's so flattering to be chosen like that.

Yeon: It's flattering in week one. By week six they'd like a vote.

Let the next one catch up. Ask one question a date that you don't already know the answer to.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fall in love. You announce it.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. You fall by melting. Their laugh, their texts, the way they said your name once.

Yeon: And then you shape yourself around them before they've even asked for anything.

Bom: Falling soft is lovely. Losing yourself isn't part of the deal.

Keep one thing that's only yours while you fall. A class, a friend night, a Sunday ritual. Protect it like it's a date.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Fall softly. Just keep your own floor under you.

base.how-you-fall:
You don't fall. You decide. Around the third conversation you look at someone and think: yes, worth building with.

Bom: And from then, you're all in.

Yeon: The catch is your decision usually arrives before their feelings do. Then you wonder why they "need time".

Bom: You aren't too much. You're just early. Let them arrive.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like a promise. Steady, loyal, the person everyone wishes they'd dated first.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You don't date. You recruit.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Trees don't wander off to see what else is growing. When you're in, you're in.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

open.title: You decided they were the one on date three. They were still on the starter.
open.text:
You don't do flings. You do futures. Somewhere in the first month you've already mentally picked the sofa.

Bom: You're the steadiest lover anyone could ask for.

Yeon: You're also the only lover who brings a roadmap to a second date.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is very specific, and it explains a lot about who you end up with. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Pine, rated honestly: you flirt like | a job interview. Strong eye contact, clear intentions, zero mystery.

sample.text: Red flag: you treat "I need space" like a problem to solve. It's a sentence. Respect the full stop.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall gradually, through closeness. A shared joke, a long walk, a text at the right moment. Then suddenly you're wrapped around them.

Bom: You love with your whole attention.

Yeon: And you quietly edit yourself to be easier to love. Less opinion. More "whatever you want".

Bom: The real you is the one they should be falling for. Let them meet it early.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like a vine. Close, gentle, wrapped around someone's whole life.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You don't have a type. You have whoever you're with, and then you become their type.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall by noticing. Their habits, their moods, what makes them laugh.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

open.title: You became a fan of their football team in a week. You hate football.
open.text:
When you like someone, you grow toward them. Their music, their jokes, their friends. You fit so naturally it feels like fate.

Bom: You make love feel easy.

Yeon: You make it so easy they forget you have preferences. You forget too, around month four.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is lovely. What you lose while falling is the part we need to talk about. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Flower: you mirror them so well | they think they found their soulmate. They found their reflection.

sample.text: Red flag: you'd rather disappear inside a relationship than risk one honest disagreement.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall through excitement. Chemistry, banter, being seen. The first spark feels like the whole sky.

Bom: In your eyes, people become the lead in a film.

Yeon: And you fall hardest for people who light up when you walk in. Which is great. Until they stop.

Bom: Look for someone who stays warm on a boring Tuesday. That's the real spark.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like sunshine. Warm, generous, everyone can feel it.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Laugh at your joke and you'll give them your whole heart and your Netflix password.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall fast and bright. When you like someone, the whole world knows by Friday.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

open.title: They laughed at your joke once. You were in love by Thursday.
open.text:
You fall like a sunrise: fast, warm, impossible to miss. Everyone knows. Your friends know. Their friends know. Your mum probably knows.

Bom: You love out loud. It's beautiful.

Yeon: It's a parade. With one guest who didn't RSVP yet.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is half the story. Who you fall for is the other half, and it's a pattern. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Sun: you flirt with everyone and | mean it with one. Nobody can tell which one, including the one.

sample.text: Red flag: you mistake attention for love. Attention is a free sample. Love is the subscription.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall slowly and completely. One long conversation and something lights. From then, you're devoted.

Bom: Your love feels like being truly known.

Yeon: Your love also comes with a memory that never deletes. Every sweet thing. Every slight.

Bom: Let the small hurts out early. Your flame burns cleaner without the smoke.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like candlelight. Close, warm, completely focused on one person.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You've also memorised their coffee order, their sister's name and their ex's star sign. Week two.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall quietly and deeply. Nobody sees it happen. Then it's everything.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

open.title: Week two and you know their ex's star sign. Normal.
open.text:
You don't fall loudly. You fall in the details. The way they hold a cup. A song they mentioned once. You keep all of it.

Bom: You love with total attention.

Yeon: You love like a very romantic private investigator.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall explains why you can't un-fall. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Candle: you don't flirt. You | pay attention so precisely it feels like flirting, and they're hooked before you've said a word.

sample.text: Red flag: you go silent to see if they'll notice. They won't. Say the words.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall like a season changes. Slowly, then one day it's just different. You feel it long before you show it.

Bom: You need to trust before you can love. That's wise.

Yeon: It's wise. It also means some people give up waiting while you're still running background checks.

Bom: Show a little before you're sure. A hint. A "I liked tonight". It helps.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like a mountain. Solid, safe, there for decades.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your crush timeline runs on geological time.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall slowly. When you finally do, you don't fall back out.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

open.title: You took eleven months to say you liked them. They'd moved cities.
open.text:
You don't rush love. You observe. You test. You wait to be sure. By the time you're sure, you're sure forever.

Bom: Your love is the safest thing a person can have.

Yeon: Your love is also on a delivery schedule of six to eight business months.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is slow. Why you fall slow is the interesting part. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Mountain: you think you're being | obvious. You are not. You've been "flirting" for a month and they think you're just polite.

sample.text: Red flag: you call it being steady. Sometimes it's just being unwilling to say what you want.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall through care. Somebody needs something, you provide it, and somewhere in the providing you fall.

Bom: You're the warmest kind of lover.

Yeon: You're also drawn to people who need fixing. Like a mechanic who only dates broken cars.

Bom: Notice who takes care of YOU. That's the person worth falling for.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like a garden. Nurturing, generous, always growing something for them.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also started meal-prepping for them before you'd even kissed.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall by caring. Looking after someone is how your heart opens.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

open.title: You meal-prepped for them before the first kiss.
open.text:
You fall by doing. The soup when they're sick. The reminder before their interview. The charger in your bag that's actually theirs.

Bom: You show love so practically.

Yeon: You show love like a very attentive personal assistant who also wants to be kissed.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is kind. Who you fall for is the plot twist. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Field: you flirt by | helping. Moving boxes. Fixing their CV. They think you're nice. You think you're seducing them.

sample.text: Red flag: you confuse being needed with being loved. Close. Not the same.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall through respect. They stand up for something, they're honest with you, they don't flinch. That's it. You're done.

Bom: When you're in, you're loyal to the end.

Yeon: You're also testing them the whole time. Little challenges. Little blunt comments. To see if they can take it.

Bom: You don't need to test love. You can just let it in.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like a sword. Loyal, protective, ready to fight for them.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your idea of a love letter is a fully serviced bike.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall through respect. Someone earns it, and then you're theirs.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

open.title: You said "I like you" by fixing their bike. Then you left.
open.text:
You don't do poetry. You do deeds. You'll defend them in public, fix their car and never once say "I missed you" out loud.

Bom: Your love is the protective kind.

Yeon: Your love is a bodyguard who refuses to admit they have feelings.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is all action. What's under the armour is on the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Sword: you flirt by | arguing. You think it's chemistry. Sometimes they think it's a debate they're losing.

sample.text: Red flag: you'd rather win the argument than admit you were hurt. Every time.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall through admiration. Their taste, their mind, the way they carry themselves. You fall for quality.

Bom: You see the beauty in people.

Yeon: You also see every flaw. And you hide your own so well that nobody gets to love the real thing.

Bom: Let one imperfect thing show early. It's how they'll know it's you they're falling for.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like a jewel. Refined, thoughtful, every gesture considered.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Every text you send has a director's cut nobody sees.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall carefully. You need it to feel right before you let it shine.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

open.title: You rewrote "had fun tonight" four times.
open.text:
You want love to be beautiful. The right words, the right timing, the right person. You don't settle, and you don't rush.

Bom: You make love feel special.

Yeon: You make love feel like an exam you're grading and taking at the same time.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is careful. Why you're so careful is the part that'll sting. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Jewel: subtle. Very subtle. So | subtle they've filed you under "friendly" and moved on.

sample.text: Red flag: you pull back the second you feel judged. Even when nobody was judging.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall through curiosity. Someone surprises you, and suddenly you can't stop thinking about them.

Bom: You love with your whole imagination.

Yeon: And when the mystery fades, part of you starts looking at the horizon.

Bom: Depth can be the new adventure. The same person, known all the way down.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like the ocean. Big, deep, full of adventure.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also fell for someone because of one conversation about black holes at 3am.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall through the mind. A great conversation is foreplay to you.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

open.title: One 3am conversation about black holes and you were gone.
open.text:
You fall for minds. The person who can keep up, who gets your weird ideas, who wants to drive somewhere random on a Tuesday.

Bom: You bring so much wonder.

Yeon: You bring wonder and an exit plan. Always both.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is fast. How you stay is the real question. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Ocean: intense, brilliant, then | gone for four days. You call it "having a life". They call it whiplash.

sample.text: Red flag: you keep one foot out the door and call it independence.

base.how-you-fall:
You fall through feeling. A look, a song, a moment where they seemed to get you. And you're gone, quietly.

Bom: Your intuition about people is usually right.

Yeon: Your intuition is right. Your timing is a crime. You wait so long they meet someone who said it first.

Bom: Say a small version of it early. "I like talking to you." That's all it takes.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love like rain. Soft, quiet, soaking into everything.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You've had a whole relationship with them. In your head. They were great in it.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You fall in silence. You feel it everywhere before you say a word.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

open.title: You fell for them three months ago. They still have no idea.
open.text:
You fall inside. Daydreams, playlists, a whole imagined future. Meanwhile, out loud, you've said "haha same" four times.

Bom: Your love is so deep.

Yeon: Your love is so deep it's never surfaced.
open.end: Yeon: How you fall is invisible. Making it visible is on the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Your flirting style, Rain: so quiet it's | practically classified. You think the playlist was obvious. It was not obvious.

sample.text: Red flag: you'd rather leave quietly than say one uncomfortable thing.
